explanation: Steinitz, born in Prague, beat Johannes Zukertort in a match played in New York, St Louis and New Orleans. Emanuel Lasker took the title from him in 1894.

claims.text: Wilhelm Steinitz became the first official world chess champion by beating Johannes Zukertort in 1886.
Paul Morphy never held the official title, and Emanuel Lasker (from 1894) and José Raúl Capablanca (from 1921) became world champion after Steinitz.
The 1886 match between Steinitz and Zukertort was played in New York, St Louis and New Orleans.
Steinitz was born in Prague, and Emanuel Lasker took the world title from him in 1894.
